snippet.title: New Trailer Reverse Horizons Indie Game
snippet.description:
The path forward is through the impossible. Wishlist Reverse Horizons on Steam today and stay tuned for the upcoming release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4356710/Reverse_Horizons/


Meet Pluma, a wanderer searching for her true self in a world of forgotten ruins. Armed with a magical staff capable of bending gravity, she must navigate uncharted paths and solve puzzles that defy the laws of physics.

In Reverse Horizons, up becomes down, and the only limit is your perspective. Are you ready to turn your world upside down?

#ReverseHorizons #IndieGame #GameDev #PuzzlePlatformer #Gravity #IndieDev #Gaming
